decisions.reason: Premium support fits the firm's core promise of round-the-clock expert support for agencies and is cheap to sustain as an upsell.
The version management tool is embedded in the firm's management toolset, reduces recurring work for customers and differentiates the platform.

The data processing contract tool is distant from the core offer, but it still meets GDPR compliance needs of hosting customers at low maintenance cost, so it is kept for now despite elevated risk of discontinuation.
Scalable agency hosting is the flagship product line and the focus of the firm's strategic direction.
